newsitem.title: USA: Plainville, Conn. approves $43.9 mln budget--paper.
newsitem.headline: Plainville, Conn. approves $43.9 mln budget--paper.

text.p: Plainville, Conn., earlier this week approved a $34.9 million budget which raises taxes by 1.1 mills in the 1998 fiscal year, which starts July 1, Hartford Courant reported Wednesday.
The tax hike brings the rate to 27.7 mills, which means that a resident who owns property with an assessed value of $100,000 must pay $2,770 in property taxes.
The budget cuts $250,000 from what the school board proposed, but this can be accomplished without laying off teachers, the paper quoted the outgoing school superintendent as saying.
The $20,789,694 school budget means the district can slightly improve the class size rato, upgrade technology and start a new, ninth-grade science course.
The town's portion of the budget is $11,315,911, and $2,880,173 is earmarked for debt service.
